Plan details
Product Specific Terms and Conditions
Yuno Dual Fuel Plan - Valid From 6/03/25
1. These Product Specific Terms and Conditions
1.1 These Product Specific Terms and Conditions (as amended from time to time) apply specifically to the services associated with the Yuno Dual Fuel Plan (the “Yuno Dual Fuel Plan T&Cs”) and are incorporated into the Contract (as defined in the General Terms and Conditions which can be found at www.yunoenergy.ie/termsandconditions), between Yuno Energy (“Yuno Energy” or “we”, “us” or “our”) and a person who agrees to enter into a Contract for the Supply of Electricity and Gas with us (“Customer” or “you” ).
1.2 In the event of any conflict between these Yuno Dual Fuel Plan T&Cs and our General Terms and Conditions these terms will prevail. Any defined terms in these Product Specific T&Cs will have the meaning given to them as defined in the General Terms and Conditions.
1.3 The Contract shall commence on the date that you sign up to the Yuno Dual Fuel Plan and agree to our General Terms and Conditions and will continue for a period of one (1) calendar year from that date (the "Initial Period").
1.4 The Yuno Dual Fuel Plan will apply for the term specified in clause 1.3, after which point you will be moved to the Yuno Standard Gas Plan and the Yuno Standard Electricity Plan.
1.5 The Dual Fuel Estimated Annual Bill (EAB) is calculated based on an average annual consumption of 11,000 kWh in gas and 4,200 kWh in electricity, as defined by the Commission for Regulation of Utilities.
1.6 Yuno Dual Fuel Plan is for customers with usage less than 73,000kWh per year.  If Gas Networks Ireland advise us that your usage is greater than 73,000kWh you will be moved to a large user gas plan.
1.7 If you are unable to complete the sign up for both electricity and gas under the Yuno Dual Fuel plan, you may sign up for one fuel (either a Yuno Electricity plan or Yuno Gas plan) separately. The EABs for these plans will be different to the Dual fuel EAB. Please refer to our price plans and terms and conditions for these Energy plans on our website at https://yunoenergy.ie/price-plans.
1.8 Should you terminate your electricity or gas account after the 14 day cooling off period but prior to the expiry of the Initial Period or without providing us with the required 30 days advanced notice of your intention to cancel a €100 termination fee will be applied to your account per fuel. You will be moved to the Yuno Standard Gas Plan or Yuno Standard Electricity plan.
1.9 Yuno Energy reserves the right to withdraw the Yuno Dual Fuel Plan without notice at any time prior to the commencement of the contract.
1.10 For Electricity and Gas all charges are subject to change in accordance with our Standard Terms and Conditions.
2. Yuno Dual Fuel Plan Offer
2.1    This Yuno Dual Fuel Plan is only available to new Yuno Energy customers.
2.2    Pricing is subject to and dependent on your location and your meter type. You must have an Electricity Supply Board Networks (ESBN) electricity smart meter installed and  a Gas Networks Ireland (GNI) gas credit meter. This plan is not available where a GNI Pay as You Go Meter is installed or if you refuse the installation of an ESBN smart meter.
Paperless Tariff
2.3 The Yuno Dual Fuel Plan is a paperless Tariff. To avail of the Yuno Dual Fuel Plan you must download our mobile App and provide us with your correct e-mail address at the time of entering into the Contract in order to receive your Energy Bills. We shall use this email address to notify you that your Energy Bills are available in your App.
2.4 We reserve the right to change your Tariff from the Yuno Dual Fuel Plan to another Tariff or otherwise terminate the Contract, if you:
2.4.1 want to receive paper Bills; or
2.4.2 are unable to download or login into our App; or
2.4.3 do not provide us with a valid up-to-date email address.
Smart Meter
2.5 The Yuno Dual Fuel Plan Tariff is dependent on us obtaining your half hourly electricity metering data from ESBN, accordingly if you wish to sign up to the Yuno Discount Dual Fuel Tariff you must have a smart Meter installed or consent to its installation when requested to do so by ESBN. Due to applicable industry rules for smart metering once you move to the Yuno Dual Fuel Plan, it is not possible to revert back to a non-smart electricity Tariff.
2.6 If you refuse to allow ESBN to install a smart Meter at your Premises or if you no longer wish to provide ESBN or us with your half hourly smart metering data you will become ineligible to avail of the Yuno Dual Fuel Tariff. We reserve the right to move you to different Tariffs for both electricity and gas or terminate the Contract. If you move to another Tariff(s) we may request a deposit from you.
2.7 If the signal from your smart Meter is not sufficient to support the transfer of half-hourly data to us via ESBN, we will contact you to discuss other suitable Tariffs for both electricity and gas.
2.8 Consumption insights in your App will only be available 30 days after the installation of an ESBN smart Meter.
3. Billing, Charges & Payment
3.1 We will issue you separate energy Bills for gas and electricity monthly or every two months in accordance with the processes set out in Clause 11 of the General Terms and Conditions. In addition to those terms, the following terms apply:
3.1.1 On signing up to the Yuno Dual Fuel Plan Tariff, you will be required to make an advanced payment which will be calculated based upon your predicted electricity consumption.
3.1.2 You can choose the date on which you wish to be billed and charged in the App. You can choose different dates to be billed for gas and electricity. Your Energy Bills may be issued on the same day that the payments are deducted from your card.
3.1.3   In the event of non-payment a bill, we will only disconnect the fuel against which the debt is unpaid.
3.1.4 If you are providing information about other people on a joint application or registering a card for payment which is not in your name, you must make sure they agree that we can use their information or payment card to do this. If you give us false or inaccurate information and fraud is identified, we will pass your details to credit-reference and fraud-prevention agencies.
3.1.5 If you do not have an ESBN Smart Meter, you will not receive usage data or daily updates until your ESBN smart Meter has been installed
3.1.6 Your Gas bill will be based on actual readings or where we have been unable to get meter readings, we will generate estimated readings or use estimated readings provided to us by GNI. To improve the accuracy of your Gas bill we encourage you to submit your meter readings to us.
3.1.7 You must pay your Energy Bills to the specific payment conditions of your Tariff. If you fail to pay us by an agreed payment date, we reserve the right to change our payment collection date and we will notify you in advance of doing this.
3.1.8 Should you fail to pay by one of the payment methods agreed between us at signup, we may change the frequency of your Energy Bills. We may also require you to pay a security deposit. We may also charge you any reasonable costs incurred by us in relation to collecting any overdue payments from you.
3.1.9 We reserve the right to move you to another Tariff if you breach the Contract.
4. Welcome Bonus (if applicable)
4.1     Welcome bonus signifies a rebate offered by us the company to you the customer. It is offered at the sole discretion of the company and may be applied to your account over the duration of the initial term.
4.2   You will only be entitled to receive a welcome bonus if it is offered to you by the company at the point of sign up. Any new welcome bonus offers will not be retrospectively applied to existing customers.
4.3    The welcome bonus is available to new Yuno Energy Customers only that sign up for this and is subject to a minimum initial term as set out in clause 1.3.
4.4    The Welcome bonus is applied to your Yuno Energy account, no cash alternatives will be offered.
4.5    Should you terminate this Contract within the initial term as specified in clause 1.3 we reserve the right to withdraw the welcome bonus and debit your account for an amount up to the value of the welcome bonus received.
4.6    Only one welcome bonus will apply per GPRN or MPRN in a twelve month period.
4.7    The welcome bonus offer can be withdrawn without notice at the discretion of the company.

Plan details
Product Specific Terms and Conditions
Dual Fuel Smart Plan Valid from 26th February 2025
1. These Product Specific Terms and Conditions
1.1 These Product Specific Terms and Conditions (as amended from time to time) apply specifically to the services associated with the Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Plan (the “Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Plan T&Cs”) and are incorporated into the Contract (as defined in the General Terms and Conditions which can be found at www.yunoenergy.ie/termsandconditions), between Yuno Energy (“Yuno Energy” or “we”, “us” or “our”) and a person who agrees to enter into a Contract for the Supply of Gas and Electricity with us (“Customer” or “you” ).
1.2 In the event of any conflict between these Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Plan T&Cs and our General Terms and Conditions these terms will prevail. Any defined terms in these Product Specific T&Cs will have the meaning given to them as defined in the General Terms and Conditions.
1.3 The Contract shall commence on the date that you sign up to the Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Plan and agree to our General Terms and Conditions and will continue for a period of one (1) calendar year from that date (the "Initial Period").
1.4 The Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Plan will apply for the term specified in clause 1.3, after which point you will be moved to the Yuno Standard Gas Plan and the Yuno Standard Electricity Plan.
1.5 The Smart Dual Fuel Estimated Annual Bill (EAB) is calculated based on an average annual consumption of 11,000 kWh in gas and 4,200 kWh in electricity, as defined by the Commission for Regulation of Utilities.
1.6 Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Plan is for customers with usage less than 73,000kWh per year.  If Gas Networks Ireland advise us that your usage is greater than 73,000kWh you will be moved to a large user gas plan.
1.7 If you are unable to complete the sign up for both electricity and gas under the Yuno Smart Dual Fuel plan, you may sign up for one fuel (either a Yuno Electricity plan or Yuno Gas plan) separately. The EABs for these plans will be different to the Yuno Smart Dual fuel plan EAB. Please refer to our price plans and terms and conditions for these Energy plans on our website at https://yunoenergy.ie/price-plans.
1.8 Should you terminate your electricity or gas account after the 14 day cooling off period but prior to the expiry of the Initial Period or without providing us with the required 30 days advanced notice of your intention to cancel a €100 termination fee will be applied to your account per fuel. You will be moved to the Yuno Standard Gas Plan or Yuno Standard Electricity plan.
1.9 Yuno Energy reserves the right to withdraw the Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Plan without notice at any time prior to the commencement of the contract.
1.10 For Electricity and Gas all charges are subject to change in accordance with our Standard Terms and Conditions
2. Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Plan Offer
2.1 This Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Plan is only available to new Yuno Energy customers.
2.2 Pricing is subject to and dependent on your location and your meter type. You must have an Electricity Supply Board Networks (ESBN) electricity Smart Meter installed and a Gas Networks Ireland (GNI) gas credit meter. This plan is not available where a GNI Pay as You Go Meter is installed or if you refuse the installation of an ESBN smart meter.
Paperless Tariff
2.3 The Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Plan is a paperless Tariff. To avail of the Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Plan you must download our mobile App and provide us with your correct e-mail address at the time of entering into the Contract in order to receive your Energy Bills. We shall use this email address to notify you that your Energy Bills are available in your App.
2.4 We reserve the right to change your Tariff from the Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Plan to another Tariff or otherwise terminate the Contract, if you:
2.4.1 want to receive paper Bills; or
2.4.2 are unable to download or login into our App; or
2.4.3 do not provide us with a valid up-to-date email address.
Smart Meter
2.5 The Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Plan Tariff is dependent on us obtaining your half hourly electricity metering data from ESBN, accordingly if you wish to sign up to the Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Tariff you must have a Smart Meter installed or consent to its installation when requested to do so by ESBN. Due to applicable industry rules for smart metering once you move to our Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Plan, it is not possible to revert back to a non-smart electricity Tariff.
2.6 If you refuse to allow ESBN to install a Smart Meter at your Premises or if you no longer wish to provide ESBN or us with your half hourly smart metering data you will become ineligible to avail of the Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Tariff. We reserve the right to move you to different Tariffs for both electricity and gas or terminate the Contract. If you move to another Tariff(s) we may request a deposit from you.
2.7 If the signal from your Smart Meter is not sufficient to support the transfer of half-hourly data to us via ESBN, we will contact you to discuss other suitable Tariffs for both electricity and gas.
2.8 Consumption insights in your App will only be available 30 days after the installation of an ESBN smart Meter.
3. Billing, Charges & Payment
3.1 We will issue you separate energy Bills for gas and electricity monthly or every two months in accordance with the processes set out in Clause 11 of the General Terms and Conditions. In addition to those terms, the following terms apply:
3.1.1 On signing up to the Yuno Smart Dual Fuel Plan Tariff, you will be required to make an advanced payment which will be calculated based upon your predicted electricity consumption.
3.1.2 You can choose the date on which you wish to be billed and charged in the App. You can choose different dates to be billed for gas and electricity. Your Energy Bills may be issued on the same day that the payments are deducted from your card.
3.1.3   In the event of non-payment a bill, we will only disconnect the fuel against which the debt is unpaid.
3.1.4 Unit rates will be charged under the following three time periods:
Day kWh rate is applicable to usage between 08:00 - 23:00 everyday.
Night kWh rate is applicable to usage between 23:00 - 08:00 everyday.
Peak kWh rate is applicable to usage between 17:00 -19:00 everyday.
3.1.5 The times/ bands set out in clause
3.1.4 above are times/ bands set by regulation and are subject to change following any future regulatory decisions.
3.1.6 If you are providing information about other people on a joint application or registering a card for payment which is not in your name, you must make sure they agree that we can use their information or payment card to do this. If you give us false or inaccurate information and fraud is identified, we will pass your details to credit-reference and fraud-prevention agencies.
3.1.7 If you do not have an ESBN Smart Meter, you will not receive usage data or daily updates until your ESBN smart Meter has been installed.
3.1.8 Your Gas bill will be based on actual readings or where we have been unable to get meter readings, we will generate estimated readings or use estimated readings provided to us by GNI. To improve the accuracy of your Gas bill we encourage you to submit your meter readings to us.
3.1.9 You must pay your Energy Bills to the specific payment conditions of your Tariff. If you fail to pay us by an agreed payment date, we reserve the right to change our payment collection date and we will notify you in advance of doing this.
3.1.10 Should you fail to pay by one of the payment methods agreed between us at signup, we may change the frequency of your Energy Bills. We may also require you to pay a security deposit. We may also charge you any reasonable costs incurred by us in relation to collecting any overdue payments from you.
3.1.11 We reserve the right to move you to another Tariff if you breach the Contract.
4. Welcome Bonus (if applicable)
4.1 Welcome bonus signifies a rebate offered by us the company to you the customer. It is offered at the sole discretion of the company and may be applied to your account over the duration of the initial term.
4.2 You will only be entitled to receive a welcome bonus if it is offered to you by the company at the point of sign up. Any new welcome bonus offers will not be retrospectively applied to existing customers.
4.3 The welcome bonus is available to new Yuno Energy Customers only that sign up for this and is subject to a minimum initial term as set out in clause 1.3.
4.4 The Welcome bonus is applied to your Yuno Energy account, no cash alternatives will be offered.
4.5 Should you terminate this Contract within the initial term as specified in clause 1.3 we reserve the right to withdraw the welcome bonus and debit your account for an amount up to the value of the welcome bonus received.
4.6 Only one welcome bonus will apply per GPRN or MPRN in a twelve month period.
4.7 The welcome bonus offer can be withdrawn without notice at the discretion of the company.

Our Cookies
We use cookies, which are small text files, to improve your experience on our website, show you personalised content, show you personalised ads that are relevant to you, to limit the number of ads you see from us and help with our marketing efforts.  Click “Accept All Cookies” to continue to our website or click on settings, to manage them individually.
Learn how Yuno Energy and our partners collect and use data in our Cookie Policy
Cookies Settings
Accept All Cookies
Privacy Preference Center
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.
More information

Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Cookies Details‎
Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.
Cookies Details‎
Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details‎
Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

Plan details
Product Specific Terms and Conditions
Variable Discount Plan Valid from 1st April 2024
1. These Product Specific Terms and Conditions
1.1 These Product Specific Terms and Conditions (as amended from time to time) apply specifically to the services associated with the Variable Discount Plan Tariff (the “Variable Discount Plan T&Cs”) and are incorporated into the Contract (as defined in the General Terms and Conditions which can be found at www.yunoenergy.ie/termsandconditions), between Yuno Energy (“Yuno Energy” or “we”, “us” or “our”) and a person who agrees to enter into a Contract for the Supply of Energy with us (“Customer” or “you” ).
1.2 In the event of any conflict between these Variable Discount Plan T&Cs and our General Terms and Conditions these terms will prevail. Any defined terms in these Product Specific T&Cs will have the meaning given to them as defined in the General Terms and Conditions.
1.3 The Contract shall commence on the date that you sign up to Yuno Energy and agree to our General Terms and Conditions and will continue for a period of one (1) calendar year from that date (the "Initial Period").
1.4 The Variable Discount Plan Tariff will apply for the term specified in clause 1.3, after which point you will be moved to the Yuno Energy Standard Price Plan Tariff.
1.5 Should you terminate the Contract after the14-day cooling off period but prior to the expiry of the Initial Period or without providing us with the required 30 days advanced notice of your intention to cancel a €100 termination fee will be applied to your account.
1.6 Yuno Energy reserves the right to withdraw the Variable Discount Plan Tariff without notice at any time prior to the commencement of the contract.
1.7 The unit rate and standing charges are subject to change in accordance with our Standard Terms and Conditions.
2. Variable Discount Plan Offer
2.1 This Variable Discount Plan Tariff is only available to new Yuno Energy electricity customers.
2.2 Pricing is subject to and dependent on your location and your meter configuration code.
Paperless Tariff
2.3 The Variable Discount Plan Tariff is a paperless Tariff. To avail of the Variable Discount Plan Tariff you must download our mobile App and provide us with your correct e-mail address at the time of entering into the Contract in order to receive your Energy Bill. We shall use this email address to notify you that your Energy Bill is available in your App.
2.4 We reserve the right to change your Tariff from the Variable Discount Plan Tariff to another Tariff or otherwise terminate the Contract, if you:
2.4.1 want to receive paper Energy Bills; or
2.4.2 are unable to download or login into our App; or
2.4.3 do not provide us with a valid up-to- date email address
Smart Meter
2.5 The Variable Discount Plan Tariff is dependent on us obtaining your half hourly metering data from ESBN, accordingly if you wish to sign up to the Variable Discount Plan Tariff you must have a smart Meter installed or consent to its installation when requested to do so by ESBN. Due to applicable industry rules for smart metering once you move to a Variable Discount Plan Tariff, it is not possible to revert back to a non-smart Tariff.
2.6 If you refuse to allow ESBN to install a smart Meter at your Premises or if you no longer wish to provide ESBN or us with your half hourly smart metering data you will become ineligible to avail of the Variable Discount Plan Tariff. We reserve the right to move you to a different Tariff or terminate the Contract. If you move to another Tariff we may request a deposit from you.
2.7 If the signal from your smart Meter is not sufficient to support the transfer of half-hourly data to us via ESBN, we will contact you to discuss other suitable Tariffs.
2.8 Consumption insights in your App will only be available 30 days after the installation of a smart Meter.
3. Billing, Charges & Payment
3.1 We will issue your Energy Bill in accordance with the processes set out in Clause 11 of the General Terms and Conditions. In addition to those terms, the following terms apply:
3.1.1 On signing up to the Variable Discount Plan Tariff, you will be required to make an advanced payment which will be calculated based upon your predicted consumption.
3.1.2 You can choose the date on which you wish to be billed and charged in the App. Your Energy Bill may be issued on the same day that the payment is deducted from your card.
3.1.3 If you do not have an ESBN Smart Meter, you will not receive usage data or daily updates until your ESBN smart Meter has been installed.
3.1.4 You must pay your Energy Bill to the specific payment conditions of your Tariff. If you fail to pay us by an agreed payment date, we reserve the right to change our payment
collection date and we will notify you in advance of doing this.
3.1.5 Should you fail to pay by one of the payment methods agreed between us at signup, we may change the frequency of your Energy Bills. We may also require you to pay a security deposit. We may also charge you any reasonable costs incurred by us in relation to collecting any overdue payments from you.
3.1.6 We reserve the right to move you to another Tariff if you breach the Contract.
4. Welcome Bonus (if applicable)
4.1 Welcome bonus signifies a rebate offered by us the company to you the customer. It is offered at the sole discretion of the company and may be applied to your account over the duration of the initial term and is subject to the successful payment of your advanced credit.
4.2 You will only be entitled to receive a welcome bonus if it is offered to you by the company at the point of sign up. Any new welcome bonus offers will not be retrospectively applied to existing customers.
4.3 The welcome bonus is available to new Yuno Energy customers only that sign up for this and is subject to a minimum initial term as set out in clause 1.3.
4.4 The Welcome bonus is applied to your Yuno Energy electricity account, no cash alternatives will be offered.
4.5 Should you terminate this Contract within the initial term as specified in clause 1.3 we reserve the right to withdraw the welcome bonus and debit your account for an amount up to the value of the welcome bonus received.
4.6 Only one welcome bonus will apply per MPRN in a twelve-month period.
4.7 The welcome bonus offer can be withdrawn without notice at the discretion of the company.

Our Cookies
We use cookies, which are small text files, to improve your experience on our website, show you personalised content, show you personalised ads that are relevant to you, to limit the number of ads you see from us and help with our marketing efforts.  Click “Accept All Cookies” to continue to our website or click on settings, to manage them individually.
Learn how Yuno Energy and our partners collect and use data in our Cookie Policy
Cookies Settings
Accept All Cookies
Privacy Preference Center
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.
More information

Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Cookies Details‎
Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.
Cookies Details‎
Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details‎
Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

            <div data-component-id="radix:field" class="field field--name-field-plan-details field--type-text-long field--label-hidden field--item"><h5>Plan details</h5><div class="ckeditor-accordion-container"><dl class="styled" data-once="ckeditorAccordions"><dt><a class="ckeditor-accordion-toggler" href="#"><span class="ckeditor-accordion-toggle"></span>Product Specific Terms and Conditions</a></dt><dd><h5><strong>Variable Discount Plan Valid from 1st April 2024</strong></h5><p><strong>1. These Product Specific Terms and Conditions</strong></p><p>1.1 These Product Specific Terms and Conditions (as amended from time to time) apply specifically to the services associated with the Variable Discount Plan Tariff (the “Variable Discount Plan T&Cs”) and are incorporated into the Contract (as defined in the General Terms and Conditions which can be found at www.yunoenergy.ie/termsandconditions), between Yuno Energy (“Yuno Energy” or “we”, “us” or “our”) and a person who agrees to enter into a Contract for the Supply of Energy with us (“Customer” or “you” ).</p><p>1.2 In the event of any conflict between these Variable Discount Plan T&Cs and our General Terms and Conditions these terms will prevail. Any defined terms in these Product Specific T&Cs will have the meaning given to them as defined in the General Terms and Conditions.</p><p>1.3 The Contract shall commence on the date that you sign up to Yuno Energy and agree to our General Terms and Conditions and will continue for a period of one (1) calendar year from that date (the "Initial Period").</p><p>1.4 The Variable Discount Plan Tariff will apply for the term specified in clause 1.3, after which point you will be moved to the Yuno Energy Standard Price Plan Tariff.</p><p>1.5 Should you terminate the Contract after the14-day cooling off period but prior to the expiry of the Initial Period or without providing us with the required 30 days advanced notice of your intention to cancel a €100 termination fee will be applied to your account.</p><p>1.6 Yuno Energy reserves the right to withdraw the Variable Discount Plan Tariff without notice at any time prior to the commencement of the contract.</p><p>1.7 The unit rate and standing charges are subject to change in accordance with our Standard Terms and Conditions.</p><p><br><br><strong>2. Variable Discount Plan Offer</strong></p><p>2.1 This Variable Discount Plan Tariff is only available to new Yuno Energy electricity customers.</p><p>2.2 Pricing is subject to and dependent on your location and your meter configuration code.</p><p> </p><p><strong>Paperless Tariff</strong></p><p>2.3 The Variable Discount Plan Tariff is a paperless Tariff. To avail of the Variable Discount Plan Tariff you must download our mobile App and provide us with your correct e-mail address at the time of entering into the Contract in order to receive your Energy Bill. We shall use this email address to notify you that your Energy Bill is available in your App.</p><p>2.4 We reserve the right to change your Tariff from the Variable Discount Plan Tariff to another Tariff or otherwise terminate the Contract, if you:</p><p>2.4.1 want to receive paper Energy Bills; or</p><p>2.4.2 are unable to download or login into our App; or</p><p>2.4.3 do not provide us with a valid up-to- date email address</p><p> </p><p><strong>Smart Meter</strong></p><p>2.5 The Variable Discount Plan Tariff is dependent on us obtaining your half hourly metering data from ESBN, accordingly if you wish to sign up to the Variable Discount Plan Tariff you must have a smart Meter installed or consent to its installation when requested to do so by ESBN. Due to applicable industry rules for smart metering once you move to a Variable Discount Plan Tariff, it is not possible to revert back to a non-smart Tariff.</p><p>2.6 If you refuse to allow ESBN to install a smart Meter at your Premises or if you no longer wish to provide ESBN or us with your half hourly smart metering data you will become ineligible to avail of the Variable Discount Plan Tariff. We reserve the right to move you to a different Tariff or terminate the Contract. If you move to another Tariff we may request a deposit from you.<br><br>2.7 If the signal from your smart Meter is not sufficient to support the transfer of half-hourly data to us via ESBN, we will contact you to discuss other suitable Tariffs.</p><p>2.8 Consumption insights in your App will only be available 30 days after the installation of a smart Meter.</p><p> </p><p><strong>3. Billing, Charges & Payment</strong></p><p>3.1 We will issue your Energy Bill in accordance with the processes set out in Clause 11 of the General Terms and Conditions. In addition to those terms, the following terms apply:</p><p>3.1.1 On signing up to the Variable Discount Plan Tariff, you will be required to make an advanced payment which will be calculated based upon your predicted consumption.</p><p>3.1.2 You can choose the date on which you wish to be billed and charged in the App. Your Energy Bill may be issued on the same day that the payment is deducted from your card.</p><p>3.1.3 If you do not have an ESBN Smart Meter, you will not receive usage data or daily updates until your ESBN smart Meter has been installed.</p><p>3.1.4 You must pay your Energy Bill to the specific payment conditions of your Tariff. If you fail to pay us by an agreed payment date, we reserve the right to change our payment<br>collection date and we will notify you in advance of doing this.</p><p>3.1.5 Should you fail to pay by one of the payment methods agreed between us at signup, we may change the frequency of your Energy Bills. We may also require you to pay a security deposit. We may also charge you any reasonable costs incurred by us in relation to collecting any overdue payments from you.</p><p>3.1.6 We reserve the right to move you to another Tariff if you breach the Contract.</p><p> </p><p><strong>4. Welcome Bonus (if applicable)</strong></p><p>4.1 Welcome bonus signifies a rebate offered by us the company to you the customer. It is offered at the sole discretion of the company and may be applied to your account over the duration of the initial term and is subject to the successful payment of your advanced credit.</p><p>4.2 You will only be entitled to receive a welcome bonus if it is offered to you by the company at the point of sign up. Any new welcome bonus offers will not be retrospectively applied to existing customers.</p><p>4.3 The welcome bonus is available to new Yuno Energy customers only that sign up for this and is subject to a minimum initial term as set out in clause 1.3.</p><p>4.4 The Welcome bonus is applied to your Yuno Energy electricity account, no cash alternatives will be offered.</p><p>4.5 Should you terminate this Contract within the initial term as specified in clause 1.3 we reserve the right to withdraw the welcome bonus and debit your account for an amount up to the value of the welcome bonus received.</p><p>4.6 Only one welcome bonus will apply per MPRN in a twelve-month period.</p><p>4.7 The welcome bonus offer can be withdrawn without notice at the discretion of the company.</p></dd></dl></div></div>

Product Specific Terms and Conditions
Variable Smart Day/Night/Peak Plan - Valid from 26th February 2025
1. These Product Specific Terms and Conditions
1.1  These Product Specific Terms and Conditions (as amended from time to time) apply specifically to the services associated with the Variable Smart Day/Night/Peak Plan (the “Variable Smart  Day/Night/Peak Plan T&Cs”) and are incorporated into the Contract (as defined in the General Terms and Conditions which can be found at www.yunoenergy.ie/termsandconditions), between Yuno Energy (“Yuno Energy” or “we”, “us” or “our”) and a person who agrees to enter into a Contract for the Supply of Energy with us (“Customer” or “you” ).
1.2  In the event of any conflict between these Variable Smart Day/Night/Peak Plan T&Cs and our General Terms and Conditions these terms will prevail. Any defined terms in these Product Specific T&Cs will have the meaning given to them as defined in the General Terms and Conditions.
1.3  The Contract shall commence on the date that you sign up to Yuno Energy and agree to our General Terms and Conditions and will continue for a period of one (1) calendar year from that date (the "Initial Period").
1.4 The Variable Smart Day/Night/Peak Plan will apply for the term specified in clause 1.3, after which point you will be moved to the Yuno Energy StandardEnergy Standard Smart Plan.
1.5  Should you terminate the Contract after the 14-day cooling off period but prior to the expiry of the Initial Period or without providing us with the required 30 days advanced notice of your intention to cancel a €100 termination fee will be applied to your account.
1.6 Yuno Energy reserves the right to withdraw the Variable Smart Day/Night/Peak Plan without notice at any time prior to the commencement of the contract.
All other charges are subject to change in accordance with our Standard Terms and Conditions.
2. Variable Smart Day/Night/Peak Plan Offer
2.1 This Variable Smart Day/Night/Peak Plan is only available to new Yuno Energy electricity customers.
2.2   Pricing is subject to and dependent on your location and your meter configuration code.
Paperless Tariff
2.3 The Variable Smart Day/Night/Pea  Plan is a paperless Tariff. To avail of the Variable Smart Day/Night/Peak Plan you must download our mobile App and provide us with your correct e-mail address at the time of entering into the Contract in order to receive your Energy Bill. We shall use this email address to notify you that your Energy Bill is available in your App.
2.4 We reserve the right to change your Tariff from the Variable Smart Day/Night/Peak Plan to another Tariff or otherwise terminate the Contract, if you:
2.4.1 want to receive paper Energy Bills; or
2.4.2 are unable to download or login into our App; or
2.4.3 do not provide us with a valid up-to-date email address.
Smart Meter
2.5 The Variable Smart Day/Night/Peak Plan is dependent on us obtaining your half hourly metering data from ESBN, accordingly if you wish to sign up to the Variable Smart Day/Night/Peak  Plan you must have a smart Meter installed. Due to applicable industry rules for smart metering once you move to the Variable Smart Day/Night/Peak Plan, it is not possible to revert back to a non-smart Tariff.
2.6  If2.6 If you no longer wish to provide ESBN or us with your half hourly smart metering data you will become ineligible to avail of Variable Smart Day/Night/Peak Plan. We reserve the right to move you to a different Tariff or terminate the Contract. If you move to another Tariff we may request a deposit from you.
2.7 If the signal from your smart Meter is not sufficient to support the transfer of half-hourly data to us via ESBN, we will contact you to discuss other suitable Tariffs.
2.8 Consumption insights in your App will only be available 30 days after the installation of a smart Meter.
3. Billing, Charges & Payment
3.1 We will issue your Energy Bill in accordance with the processes set out in Clause 11 of the General Terms and Conditions. In addition to those terms, the following terms apply:
3.1.1 On signing up to the Variable Smart Day/Night/Peak Plan, you will be required to make an advanced payment which will be calculated based upon your predicted consumption.
3.1.2 You can choose the date on which you wish to be billed and charged in the App. Your Energy Bill may be issued on the same day that the payment is deducted from your card.
3.1.3 You must pay your Energy Bill to the specific payment conditions of your Tariff. If you fail to pay us by an agreed payment date, we reserve the right to change our payment collection date and we will notify you in advance of doing this.
3.1.4 Should you fail to pay by one of the payment methods agreed between us at signup, we may change the frequency of your Energy Bills. We may also require you to pay a security deposit. We may also charge you any reasonable costs incurred by us in relation to collecting any overdue payments from you.
3.1.5 We reserve the right to move you to another Tariff if you breach the Contract.
3.1.6 Our Unit rates will be charged under the following three time periods:
Day kWh rate is applicable to usage between 08:00 - 23:00 everyday. (excluding Peak Times)
Night kWh rate is applicable to usage between 23:00 - 08:00 everyday
Peak kWh rate is applicable to usage between 17:00 – 19:00 everyday
4. Welcome Bonus (if applicable)
4.1     Welcome bonus signifies a rebate offered by us the company to you the customer. It is offered at the sole discretion of the company and may be applied to your account over the duration of the initial term and is subject to the successful payment of your advanced credit.
4.2   You will only be entitled to receive a welcome bonus if it is offered to you by the company at the point of sign up. Any new welcome bonus offers will not be retrospectively applied to existing customers.
4.3    The welcome bonus is available to new Yuno Energy customers only that sign up for this and is subject to a minimum initial term as set out in clause 1.3.
4.4    The Welcome bonus is applied to your Yuno Energy electricity account, no cash alternatives will be offered.
4.5    Should you terminate this Contract within the initial term as specified in clause 1.3 we reserve the right to withdraw the welcome bonus and debit your account for an amount up to the value of the welcome bonus received.
4.6    Only one welcome bonus will apply per MPRN in a twelve-month period.
4.7    The welcome bonus offer can be withdrawn without notice  at the discretion of the company.

Our Cookies
We use cookies, which are small text files, to improve your experience on our website, show you personalised content, show you personalised ads that are relevant to you, to limit the number of ads you see from us and help with our marketing efforts.  Click “Accept All Cookies” to continue to our website or click on settings, to manage them individually.

Privacy Preference Center
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. Plan details
Product Specific Terms and Conditions
Electric Vehicle Discount Plan - 24hr with Night Assist – Valid from 23rd April 2025
1. These Product Specific Terms and Conditions
1.1
These Product Specific Terms and Conditions (as amended from time to time) apply specifically to the services associated with the Electric Vehicle  Discount Plan Tariff (the “Electric Vehicle Discount Plan T&Cs”) and are incorporated into the Contract (as defined in the General Terms and Conditions which can be found at www.yunoenergy.ie/termsandconditions), between Yuno Energy (“Yuno Energy” or “we”, “us” or “our”) and a person who agrees to enter into a Contract for the Supply of Energy with us (“Customer” or “you” ).
1.2
In the event of any conflict between these Electric Vehicle Discount Plan T&Cs and our General Terms and Conditions these terms will prevail. Any defined terms in these Product Specific T&Cs will have the meaning given to them as defined in the General Terms and Conditions.
1.3
The Contract shall commence on the date that you sign up to Yuno Energy and agree to our General Terms and Conditions and will continue for a period of one (1) calendar year from that date (the "Initial Period").
1.4
The Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff will apply for the term specified in clause 1.3, after which point you will be moved to the Yuno Energy Electric Vehicle Standard Price Plan Tariff.
1.5
Should you terminate the Contract after the 14 day cooling off period but prior to the expiry of the Initial Period or without providing us with the required 30 days advanced notice of your intention to cancel a €50 termination fee will be applied to your account.
1.6
Yuno Energy reserves the right to withdraw the Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff without notice at any time prior to the commencement of the contract.
1.7
The unit rate and standing charges are subject to change in accordance with our Standard Terms and Conditions.
2. Variable Discount Plan Offer
2.1
This Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff is only available to new Yuno Energy electricity customers.
Paperless Tariff
2.2
The Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff is a paperless Tariff. To avail of the Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff you must download our mobile App and provide us with your correct e-mail address at the time of entering into the Contract in order to receive your Energy Bill. We shall use this email address to notify you that your Energy Bill is available in your App.
2.3
We reserve the right to change your Tariff from the Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff to another Tariff or otherwise terminate the Contract, if you:
2.3.1 want to receive paper Energy Bills; or
2.3.2 are unable to download or login into our App; or
2.3.3 do not provide us with a valid up-to-date email address.
Smart Meter
2.4 The Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff is dependent on us obtaining your half hourly metering data from ESBN, accordingly if you wish to sign up to the Electric Vehicle Discount  Plan Tariff you must have a smart Meter installed. Due to applicable industry rules for smart metering once you move to a Electric Vehicle Discount  Plan Tariff, it is not possible to revert back to a non-smart Tariff.
2.5 If you no longer wish to provide ESBN or us with your half hourly smart metering data you will become ineligible to avail of the Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff. We reserve the right to move you to a different Tariff or terminate the Contract. If you move to another Tariff we may request a deposit from you.
2.6 If the signal from your smart Meter is not sufficient to support the transfer of half-hourly data to us via ESBN, we will contact you to discuss other suitable Tariffs.
2.7 Consumption insights in your App will only be available 30 days after the installation of a smart Meter.
3. Billing, Charges & Payment
3.1 We will issue your Energy Bill in accordance with the processes set out in Clause 11 of the General Terms and Conditions. In addition to those terms, the following terms apply:
3.1.1 On signing up to the Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff, you will be required to make an advanced payment which will be calculated based upon your predicted consumption.
3.1.2 You can choose the date on which you wish to be billed and charged in the App. Your Energy Bill may be issued on the same day that the payment is deducted from your card.
3.1.3 You must pay your Energy Bill to the specific payment conditions of your Tariff. If you fail to pay us by an agreed payment date, we reserve the right to change our payment collection date and we will notify you in advance of doing this.
3.1.4 Should you fail to pay by one of the payment methods agreed between us at signup, we may change the frequency of your Energy Bills and. We may also require you to pay a security deposit. We may also charge you any reasonable costs incurred by us in relation to collecting any overdue payments from you.
3.1.5 We reserve the right to move you to another Tariff if you breach the Contract.
3.1.6 Unit rates will be charged under the following two time periods:
24 hour kWh rate is applicable to usage between 08:00 – 08:00 everyday​ (excluding Night EV times)​.
Night EV kWh rate is applicable to usage between 02:00 - 06:00 everyday.​
4. Welcome Bonus (if applicable)
4.1 Welcome bonus signifies a rebate offered by us the company to you the customer. It is offered at the sole discretion of the company and may be applied to your account over the duration of the initial term and is subject to the successful payment of your advanced credit.
4.2 You will only be entitled to receive a welcome bonus if it is offered to you by the company at the point of sign up. Any new welcome bonus offers will not be retrospectively applied to existing customers.
4.3 The welcome bonus is available to new Yuno Energy customers only that sign up for this and is subject to a minimum initial term as set out in clause 1.3.
4.4 The Welcome bonus is applied to your Yuno Energy electricity account, no cash alternatives will be offered.
4.5 Should you terminate this Contract within the initial term as specified in clause 1.3 we reserve the right to withdraw the welcome bonus and debit your account for an amount up to the value of the welcome bonus received. 4.6 Only one welcome bonus will apply per MPRN in a twelve-month period.
4.7 The welcome bonus offer can be withdrawn without notice at the discretion of the company.

Our Cookies
We use cookies, which are small text files, to improve your experience on our website, show you personalised content, show you personalised ads that are relevant to you, to limit the number of ads you see from us and help with our marketing efforts.  Click “Accept All Cookies” to continue to our website or click on settings, to manage them individually.
Learn how Yuno Energy and our partners collect and use data in our Cookie Policy
Cookies Settings
Accept All Cookies
Privacy Preference Center
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.
More information
Allow All
Manage Consent Preferences
Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Cookies Details‎
Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.
Cookies Details‎
Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details‎
Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

These Product Specific Terms and Conditions </strong></p><p>1.1 <span lang="EN-US">These Product Specific Terms and Conditions (as amended from time to time) apply specifically to the services associated with the Electric Vehicle  Discount Plan Tariff (the “Electric Vehicle Discount Plan T&Cs”) and are incorporated into the Contract (as defined in the General Terms and Conditions which can be found at www.yunoenergy.ie/termsandconditions), between Yuno Energy (“Yuno Energy” or “we”, “us” or “our”) and a person who agrees to enter into a Contract for the Supply of Energy with us (“Customer” or “you” ).</span></p><p>1.2 <span lang="EN-US">In the event of any conflict between these Electric Vehicle Discount Plan T&Cs and our General Terms and Conditions these terms will prevail. Any defined terms in these Product Specific T&Cs will have the meaning given to them as defined in the General Terms and Conditions.</span></p><p>1.3 <span lang="EN-US">The Contract shall commence on the date that you sign up to Yuno Energy and agree to our General Terms and Conditions and will continue for a period of one (1) calendar year from that date (the "Initial Period").</span></p><p>1.4 <span lang="EN-US">The Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff will apply for the term specified in clause 1.3, after which point you will be moved to the Yuno Energy Electric Vehicle Standard Price Plan Tariff.</span></p><p>1.5 <span lang="EN-US">Should you terminate the Contract after the 14 day cooling off period but prior to the expiry of the Initial Period or without providing us with the required 30 days advanced notice of your intention to cancel a €50 termination fee will be applied to your account.</span></p><p>1.6  <span lang="EN-US">Yuno Energy reserves the right to withdraw the Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff without notice at any time prior to the commencement of the contract.</span></p><p>1.7  <span lang="EN-US">The unit rate and standing charges are subject to change in accordance with our Standard Terms and Conditions.</span></p><p> </p><p><strong>2. Variable Discount Plan Offer</strong></p><p>2.1 <span lang="EN-US">This Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff is only available to new Yuno Energy electricity customers. </span></p><p> </p><p><strong>Paperless Tariff</strong></p><p>2.2 <span lang="EN-US">The Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff is a paperless Tariff. To avail of the Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff you must download our mobile App and provide us with your correct e-mail address at the time of entering into the Contract in order to receive your Energy Bill. We shall use this email address to notify you that your Energy Bill is available in your App.</span></p><p>2.3 <span lang="EN-US">We reserve the right to change your Tariff from the Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff to another Tariff or otherwise terminate the Contract, if you:</span></p><p><span lang="EN-US">2.3.1 want to receive paper Energy Bills; or</span></p><p><span lang="EN-US">2.3.2 are unable to download or login into our App; or</span></p><p><span lang="EN-US">2.3.3 do not provide us with a valid up-to-date email address.</span></p><p> </p><p><strong>Smart Meter</strong></p><p><span lang="EN-US">2.4 The Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff is dependent on us obtaining your half hourly metering data from ESBN, accordingly if you wish to sign up to the Electric Vehicle Discount  Plan Tariff you must have a smart Meter installed. Due to applicable industry rules for smart metering once you move to a Electric Vehicle Discount  Plan Tariff, it is not possible to revert back to a non-smart Tariff.</span></p><p><span lang="EN-US"></span></p><p><span lang="EN-US">2.5 If you no longer wish to provide ESBN or us with your half hourly smart metering data you will become ineligible to avail of the Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff. We reserve the right to move you to a different Tariff or terminate the Contract. If you move to another Tariff we may request a deposit from you.</span></p><p><span lang="EN-US"></span></p><p><span lang="EN-US">2.6 If the signal from your smart Meter is not sufficient to support the transfer of half-hourly data to us via ESBN, we will contact you to discuss other suitable Tariffs.</span></p><p><span lang="EN-US"></span></p><p><span lang="EN-US">2.7 Consumption insights in your App will only be available 30 days after the installation of a smart Meter.</span></p><p> </p><p><strong>3. Billing, Charges & Payment</strong></p><p><span lang="EN-US">3.1 We will issue your Energy Bill in accordance with the processes set out in Clause 11 of the General Terms and Conditions. In addition to those terms, the following terms apply:</span></p><p><span lang="EN-US">3.1.1 On signing up to the Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff, you will be required to make an advanced payment which will be calculated based upon your predicted consumption.</span></p><p><span lang="EN-US">3.1.2 You can choose the date on which you wish to be billed and charged in the App. Your Energy Bill may be issued on the same day that the payment is deducted from your card.</span></p><p><span lang="EN-US">3.1.3 You must pay your Energy Bill to the specific payment conditions of your Tariff. If you fail to pay us by an agreed payment date, we reserve the right to change our payment collection date and we will notify you in advance of doing this.</span></p><p><span lang="EN-US">3.1.4 Should you fail to pay by one of the payment methods agreed between us at signup, we may change the frequency of your Energy Bills and. We may also require you to pay a security deposit. We may also charge you any reasonable costs incurred by us in relation to collecting any overdue payments from you.</span></p><p><span lang="EN-US">3.1.5 We reserve the right to move you to another Tariff if you breach the Contract.</span></p><p><span lang="EN-US">3.1.6 Unit rates will be charged under the following two time periods:</span></p><ul><li><span lang="EN-US"></span><span lang="EN-US">24 hour kWh rate is applicable to usage between 08:00 – 08:00 everyday​ (excluding Night EV times)​.</span></li><li><span lang="EN-US"></span><span lang="EN-US">Night EV kWh rate is applicable to usage between 02:00 - 06:00 everyday.​</span><span lang="EN-US"></span></li></ul><div class="table-responsive"><p> </p><p><strong>4. Welcome Bonus (if applicable)</strong></p><p><span lang="EN-US">4.1 Welcome bonus signifies a rebate offered by us the company to you the customer. It is offered at the sole discretion of the company and may be applied to your account over the duration of the initial term and is subject to the successful payment of your advanced credit. </span></p><p><span lang="EN-US">4.2 You will only be entitled to receive a welcome bonus if it is offered to you by the company at the point of sign up. Any new welcome bonus offers will not be retrospectively applied to existing customers. </span></p><p><span lang="EN-US">4.3 The welcome bonus is available to new Yuno Energy customers only that sign up for this and is subject to a minimum initial term as set out in clause 1.3. </span></p><p><span lang="EN-US">4.4 The Welcome bonus is applied to your Yuno Energy electricity account, no cash alternatives will be offered. </span></p><p><span lang="EN-US">4.5 Should you terminate this Contract within the initial term as specified in clause 1.3 we reserve the right to withdraw the welcome bonus and debit your account for an amount up to the value of the welcome bonus received. 4.6 Only one welcome bonus will apply per MPRN in a twelve-month period. </span></p><p><span lang="EN-US">4.7 The welcome bonus offer can be withdrawn without notice at the discretion of the company.</span></p></div></dd></dl></div><h4> </h4></div>

Plan details
Product Specific Terms and Conditions
1. These Product Specific Terms and Conditions
1.1  These Product Specific Terms and Conditions (as amended from time to time) apply specifically to the services associated with the Electric Vehicle  Discount Plan Tariff (the “Electric Vehicle Discount Plan T&Cs”) and are incorporated into the Contract (as defined in the General Terms and Conditions which can be found at www.yunoenergy.ie/termsandconditions), between Yuno Energy (“Yuno Energy” or “we”, “us” or “our”) and a person who agrees to enter into a Contract for the Supply of Energy with us (“Customer” or “you” ).
1.2 In the event of any conflict between these Electric Vehicle Discount Plan T&Cs and our General Terms and Conditions these terms will prevail. Any defined terms in these Product Specific T&Cs will have the meaning given to them as defined in the General Terms and Conditions.
1.3 The Contract shall commence on the date that you sign up to Yuno Energy and agree to our General Terms and Conditions and will continue for a period of one (1) calendar year from that date (the "Initial Period").
1.4 The Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff will apply for the term specified in clause 1.3, after which point you will be moved to the Yuno Energy Electric Vehicle Standard Price Plan Tariff.
1.5 Should you terminate the Contract after the 14 day cooling off period but prior to the expiry of the Initial Period or without providing us with the required 30 days advanced notice of your intention to cancel a €50 termination fee will be applied to your account.
1.6 Yuno Energy reserves the right to withdraw the Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff without notice at any time prior to the commencement of the contract.
1.7 The unit rate and standing charges are subject to change in accordance with our Standard Terms and Conditions.
2. Electric Vehicle Plan Offer
2.1 This Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff is only available to new Yuno Energy electricity customers.
Paperless Tariff
2.2 The Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff is a paperless Tariff. To avail of the Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff you must download our mobile App and provide us with your correct e-mail address at the time of entering into the Contract in order to receive your Energy Bill. We shall use this email address to notify you that your Energy Bill is available in your App.
2.3 We reserve the right to change your Tariff from the Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff to another Tariff or otherwise terminate the Contract, if you:
2.3.1 want to receive paper Energy Bills; or
2.3.2 are unable to download or login into our App; or
2.3.3 do not provide us with a valid up-to-date email address.
Smart Meter
2.4 The Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff is dependent on us obtaining your half hourly metering data from ESBN, accordingly if you wish to sign up to the Electric Vehicle Discount  Plan Tariff you must have a smart Meter installed. Due to applicable industry rules for smart metering once you move to a Electric Vehicle Discount  Plan Tariff, it is not possible to revert back to a non-smart Tariff.
2.5 If you no longer wish to provide ESBN or us with your half hourly smart metering data you will become ineligible to avail of the Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff. We reserve the right to move you to a different Tariff or terminate the Contract. If you move to another Tariff we may request a deposit from you.
2.6 If the signal from your smart Meter is not sufficient to support the transfer of half-hourly data to us via ESBN, we will contact you to discuss other suitable Tariffs.
2.7 Consumption insights in your App will only be available 30 days after the installation of a smart Meter.
3. Billing, Charges & Payment
3.1 We will issue your Energy Bill in accordance with the processes set out in Clause 11 of the General Terms and Conditions. In addition to those terms, the following terms apply:
3.1.1 On signing up to the Electric Vehicle Discount Plan Tariff, you will be required to make an advanced payment which will be calculated based upon your predicted consumption.
3.1.2 You can choose the date on which you wish to be billed and charged in the App. Your Energy Bill may be issued on the same day that the payment is deducted from your card.
3.1.3 You must pay your Energy Bill to the specific payment conditions of your Tariff. If you fail to pay us by an agreed payment date, we reserve the right to change our payment collection date and we will notify you in advance of doing this.
3.1.4 Should you fail to pay by one of the payment methods agreed between us at signup, we may change the frequency of your Energy Bills and. We may also require you to pay a security deposit. We may also charge you any reasonable costs incurred by us in relation to collecting any overdue payments from you.
3.1.5 We reserve the right to move you to another Tariff if you breach the Contract.
3.1.6 Unit rates will be charged under the following four time periods:
Day kWh rate is applicable to usage between 08:00 - 23:00 everyday
(excluding Peak)
​.​
Night kWh rate is applicable to usage between 23:00 - 08:00 everyday (excluding Night EV times)​.
Peak kWh rate is applicable to usage between 17:00 - 19:00 everyday.
Night EV kWh rate is applicable to usage between 02:00 - 06:00 everyday​.
4. Welcome Bonus (if applicable)
4.1 Welcome bonus signifies a rebate offered by us the company to you the customer. It is offered at the sole discretion of the company and may be applied to your account over the duration of the initial term and is subject to the successful payment of your advanced credit.
4.2 You will only be entitled to receive a welcome bonus if it is offered to you by the company at the point of sign up. Any new welcome bonus offers will not be retrospectively applied to existing customers.
4.3 The welcome bonus is available to new Yuno Energy customers only that sign up for this and is subject to a minimum initial term as set out in clause 1.3.
4.4 The Welcome bonus is applied to your Yuno Energy electricity account, no cash alternatives will be offered.
4.5 Should you terminate this Contract within the initial term as specified in clause 1.3 we reserve the right to withdraw the welcome bonus and debit your account for an amount up to the value of the welcome bonus received.
4.6 Only one welcome bonus will apply per MPRN in a twelve-month period.
4.7 The welcome bonus offer can be withdrawn without notice at the discretion of the company.

Our Cookies
We use cookies, which are small text files, to improve your experience on our website, show you personalised content, show you personalised ads that are relevant to you, to limit the number of ads you see from us and help with our marketing efforts.  Click “Accept All Cookies” to continue to our website or click on settings, to manage them individually.
Learn how Yuno Energy and our partners collect and use data in our Cookie Policy
Cookies Settings
Accept All Cookies
Privacy Preference Center
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.
More information
Allow All
Manage Consent Preferences
Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Cookies Details‎
Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.
Cookies Details‎
Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details‎
Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

1.2 In the event of any conflict between these Yuno Variable Gas Plan T&Cs and our General Terms and Conditions these terms will prevail. Any defined terms in these Product Specific T&Cs will have the meaning given to them as defined in the General Terms and Conditions.
1.3 The Contract shall commence on the date that you sign up to the Yuno Variable Gas Plan and agree to our General Terms and Conditions and will continue for a period of one (1) calendar year from that date (the "Initial Period").
1.4 The Yuno Variable Gas Plan will apply for the term specified in clause 1.3, after which point you will be moved to the Yuno Standard Gas Plan.
1.5 The Yuno Variable Gas Plan Estimated Annual Bill (EAB) is calculated based on an average annual consumption of 11,000 kWh in gas as defined by the Commission for Regulation of Utilities.
1.6 Yuno Variable Gas Plan is for customers with usage less than 73,000kWh per year.  If Gas Networks Ireland advise us that your usage is greater than 73,000kWh you will be moved to a large user gas plan.
1.7 Should you terminate the Contract after the 14-day cooling off period but prior to the expiry of the Initial Period or without providing us with the required 30 days advanced notice of your intention to cancel a €100 termination fee will be applied to your account.
1.8 Yuno Energy reserves the right to withdraw the Yuno Variable Gas Plan without notice at any time prior to the commencement of the contract.
1.9 All charges are subject to change in accordance with our Standard Terms and Conditions.
2. Fixed Discount Gas Plan Offer
2.1    This Yuno Variable Gas Plan is only available to new Yuno Energy Gas customers.
2.2    Pricing is subject to and dependent on your location and your meter type. You must have a Gas Networks Ireland (GNI) gas credit meter. This plan is not available where a GNI Pay as You Go Meter is installed.
Paperless Tariff
2.3 The Yuno Variable Gas Plan is a paperless Tariff. To avail of the Yuno Variable Gas Plan, you must download our mobile App and provide us with your correct e-mail address at the time of entering into the Contract in order to receive your Gas Bill. We shall use this email address to notify you that your Gas Bill is available in your App.
2.4 We reserve the right to change your Tariff from the Yuno Gas Plan to another Tariff or otherwise terminate the Contract, if you:
2.4.1 want to receive paper Bills; or
2.4.2 are unable to download or login into our App; or
2.4.3 do not provide us with a valid up-to-date email address.
3. Billing, Charges & Payment
3.1 We will issue your Gas Bill monthly or every two months in accordance with the processes set out in Clause 11 of the General Terms and Conditions. In addition to those terms, the following terms apply:
3.1.1 On signing up to the Yuno Variable Gas Plan you can choose the date on which you wish to be billed and charged in the App. Your Gas Bill may be issued on the same day that the payment is deducted from your card.
3.1.2 If you are providing information about other people on a joint application or registering a card for payment which is not in your name, you must make sure they agree that we can use their information or payment card to do this. If you give us false or inaccurate information and fraud is identified, we will pass your details to credit-reference and fraud-prevention agencies.
3.1.3 Your Gas bill will be based on actual readings or where we have been unable to get meter readings, we will generate estimated readings or use estimated readings provided to us by GNI. To improve the accuracy of your Gas bill we encourage you to submit your meter readings to us.
3.1.4 You must pay your Gas Bill to the specific payment conditions of your Tariff. If you fail to pay us by an agreed payment date, we reserve the right to change our payment collection date and we will notify you in advance of doing this.
3.1.4 Should you fail to pay by one of the payment methods agreed between us at signup, we may change the frequency of your Gas Bills. We may also require you to pay a security deposit. We may also charge you any reasonable costs incurred by us in relation to collecting any overdue payments from you.
3.1.5 We reserve the right to move you to another Tariff if you breach the Contract.
4. Welcome Bonus (if applicable)
4.1     Welcome bonus signifies a rebate offered by us the company to you the customer. It is offered at the sole discretion of the company and may be applied to your account over the duration of the initial term.
4.2   You will only be entitled to receive a welcome bonus if it is offered to you by the company at the point of sign up. Any new welcome bonus offers will not be retrospectively applied to existing customers.
4.3    The welcome bonus is available to new Yuno Energy Gas Customers only that sign up for this and is subject to a minimum initial term as set out in clause 1.3.
4.4    The Welcome bonus is applied to your Yuno Energy Gas account, no cash alternatives will be offered.
4.5    Should you terminate this Contract within the initial term as specified in clause 1.3 we reserve the right to withdraw the welcome bonus and debit your account for an amount up to the value of the welcome bonus received.
4.6    Only one welcome bonus will apply per GPRN or MPRN in a twelve month period.
4.7    The welcome bonus offer can be withdrawn without notice at the discretion of the company.

Our Cookies
We use cookies, which are small text files, to improve your experience on our website, show you personalised content, show you personalised ads that are relevant to you, to limit the number of ads you see from us and help with our marketing efforts.  Click “Accept All Cookies” to continue to our website or click on settings, to manage them individually.
Learn how Yuno Energy and our partners collect and use data in our Cookie Policy
Cookies Settings
Accept All Cookies
Privacy Preference Center
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.
More information
Allow All
Manage Consent Preferences
Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Cookies Details‎
Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.
Cookies Details‎
Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details‎
Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
